TASKS_DESCRIPTION: Review AI tasks that failed, stopped making progress, or need a recovery action.
TASK_QUEUE_DESCRIPTION: This list shows the latest recorded task progress. A lost connection does not mean the task finished.
PROVIDERS_DESCRIPTION: Review configured AI services and their current connection status.
PROVIDER_DIRECTORY_DESCRIPTION: Manage service connections, model mappings, test status, and lifecycle.
WORKSPACE_AI_ROLLOUT_DESCRIPTION: Review and enable AI Services for eligible workspaces. Provider readiness and workspace rollout remain separate controls.
WORKSPACE_AI_ROLLOUT_CONFIRM_TITLE: Enable AI Services for eligible workspaces?
WORKSPACE_AI_ROLLOUT_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: This reviewed change makes AI Services newly available to {{count}} of {{eligible}} eligible workspaces.
WORKSPACE_AI_ROLLOUT_REASON: Enable AI Services for eligible workspaces from the AI Services provider console
AI_SERVICES_ROLLOUT_OPERATIONAL_CONSEQUE: Eligible workspaces can use configured, active, and healthy AI services after this rollout is applied.
ASSISTANTS_DESCRIPTION: Review official assistant definitions and their current availability.
POLICIES_DESCRIPTION: Review the published operating rules for each built-in assistant.
TASK_ACTION_UNCONFIRMED_DESCRIPTION: The service has not returned the result of this action. You can try the same action again, or check the task status before taking a different action.
ACTION_RETRY_PORT_UNAVAILABLE: Retry is not currently offered for this task.
ACTION_CANCEL_PORT_UNAVAILABLE: Cancellation is not currently offered for this task.
ACTION_RECONCILE_PORT_UNAVAILABLE: Result checking is not currently offered for this task.
ACTION_RETRY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Retry is available only after the task and its background work have failed.
ACTION_CANCEL_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This task cannot be safely cancelled in its current state.
ACTION_RECONCILE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: You can check the result only when it is partial or still unknown.
ACTION_PORT_UNAVAILABLE: This recovery action is not available for the task right now.
ACTION_STATE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This recovery action is not available in the task's current state.
ACTION_AVAILABILITY_MISSING: The service did not say whether this action is available.
UNAVAILABLE_ROTATE_CREDENTIALS: Credential rotation is not available for this service right now
UNAVAILABLE_REMOVE_CREDENTIALS: Credential removal is not available for this service right now
NO_ROUTABLE_PROVIDER_WARNING: This change would leave no AI services available.
ROUTABLE_PROVIDER_COUNT: AI services available after this change: {{count}}
ADD_PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: Connect an AI service with real credentials. Credentials are never shown again after you submit them.
PROVIDER_EMPTY_ALL_DESCRIPTION: Add an AI service to expose only its explicitly mapped models to the product.
PROVIDER_EMPTY_ACTIVE_DESCRIPTION: Enable a configured service to make it available for requests.
PROVIDER_EMPTY_ARCHIVED_DESCRIPTION: Archived services will appear here for restoration or cleanup.
PROVIDER_BASIC_SECTION_DESCRIPTION: Set the provider identity and internal management notes.
PROVIDER_CONNECTION_SECTION_DESCRIPTION: Configure the real request endpoint and write-only service credential.
PROVIDER_ADVANCED_SECTION_DESCRIPTION: Choose the API request format and authentication header required by the provider.
MODEL_MAPPING_SECTION_DESCRIPTION: Only models explicitly configured here are exposed to the product. Product names and descriptions come from this mapping.
MODEL_TEST_SECTION_DESCRIPTION: Configure the smallest request used to verify provider connectivity.
BILLING_SECTION_DESCRIPTION: Set costs per million tokens in micro-US dollars.
PROVIDER_ICON_THEME_HELP: The icon switches automatically with the resolved light or dark theme in both applications.
PROVIDER_ICON_UPLOAD_ERROR: Choose a PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG image no larger than 512 KB.
PROVIDER_ICON_VARIANTS_REQUIRED: Configure both light and dark theme icons, or clear both.
PROVIDER_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Enter the service name, provider, API key, at least one complete model mapping, and a default model.
MODEL_LOCALIZATION_DESCRIPTION: Localized values override the default display copy in the matching product language.
TEST_UNAVAILABLE_ARCHIVED: Archived services cannot run connection tests.
AVAILABILITY_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE: The service cannot change availability in its current state.
DISABLE_BEFORE_ARCHIVE: Disable the service before archiving it.
ARCHIVE_WILL_DISABLE: Archiving will show the disable impact and request confirmation first.
RESTORE_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE: The service cannot be restored in its current state.
ARCHIVE_BEFORE_DELETE: Disable and archive the service before deleting it.
DELETE_BLOCKED_BY_CLEANUP: LiteLLM resources still need cleanup before this service can be deleted.
DELETE_RETRIES_CLEANUP: Deleting retries LiteLLM cleanup. If cleanup fails, the service is kept and the error is shown.
DELETE_WILL_PREPARE: The required disable and archive confirmations will be completed before deletion.
DELETE_PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: The system archives “{{name}}” first when needed, then permanently deletes its LiteLLM credential and model deployments. This action cannot be undone.
LABEL: Label
PLACEHOLDER_PROVIDER_NOTE: Record the purpose, owner, or usage limits
PLACEHOLDER_MODEL_DESCRIPTION: Describe the model's best use in the product
PLACEHOLDER_TEST_PROMPT: For example, reply with OK only
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no records to show.
ERROR_TITLE: AI service records could not be loaded
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: AI service or task records are not available right now. Try again; no status is assumed from missing data.
EDIT_PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: Update this AI service. Saved credentials are never shown.
API_KEY_WRITE_ONLY_HELP: The API key is stored encrypted and is never shown again. Leave this blank to reuse the saved credential, or enter a new key to rotate it.
PROVIDER_CHANGE_ERROR: The service has not confirmed this change. Review the current settings before trying again.
PROVIDER_CHANGE_PERMISSION_ERROR: You don't have permission to change this AI service.
PROVIDER_CHANGE_CONFLICT_ERROR: This AI service changed elsewhere. Refresh and review it before trying again.
PROVIDER_CHANGE_VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the service details and try again.
POLICIES_UNAVAILABLE_DESCRIPTION: This version does not provide AI policy settings that can be safely saved. Existing assistants and AI services will not be changed from this page.
NAME: Name
CREATE_ASSISTANT_DESCRIPTION: Set up an assistant with its purpose, instructions, and action confirmation settings. It will not be used until you publish a version.
EDIT_ASSISTANT_DESCRIPTION: Update this assistant's details. Existing published versions are not changed.
ASSISTANT_SLUG_DESCRIPTION: This advanced, permanent identifier cannot be changed after the assistant is created.
ASSISTANT_AVATAR_DESCRIPTION: An optional image that helps people identify this assistant.
ASSISTANT_INSTRUCTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Explain what this assistant should do and any important limits.
APPROVAL_PROFILE_DESCRIPTION: Choose when a person must confirm an action before it runs.
CREATE_ASSISTANT_VERSION_DESCRIPTION: Create a new version of {{name}}. Review its instructions and tool access before publishing.
TOOL_ACCESS_DESCRIPTION: Choose which tools this version can use. This is an advanced setting.
ASSISTANT_VERSION_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Complete the required version details and choose at least one way of working.
APPROVAL_PROFILE_HUMAN_REVIEW: Ask for confirmation before sensitive actions
TOOL_ACCESS_NONE: No tools are available to this assistant.
ASSISTANT_PUBLICATION_UNAVAILABLE_TITLE: New assistant versions cannot be published yet
ASSISTANT_PUBLICATION_UNAVAILABLE_DESCRI: The service that checks a version before publishing is not connected. You can save drafts and edit custom assistants, but they cannot be put into use until that check is available.
ASSISTANT_CATALOG_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create an assistant to save its purpose, instructions, and confirmation rules as a draft.
